external.name: RiceLeafBD Sylhet-Dhaka (Kaggle copy sikanderk/riceleafbd-mendeley; unseen district)
RiceLeafDisease-BD5 Savar (Kaggle copy sohagdewan/riceleafdisease-bd5, 3,150 imgs; provenance not verified vs Mendeley v2)

limitations: Leaf Smut has no external test data.
Training images come from one district (Gazipur) and one season.

On photos from other districts the accuracy drops sharply: Sylhet-Dhaka 52% (mapped classes, 1,560 images) and Savar 34% (3,150 images, cut leaves on white background). Brown spot is rarely recognised outside Gazipur.
External test sets are community Kaggle copies of the published datasets; their provenance was not verified file-by-file against Mendeley.
This is a research prototype: use the result as a first hint and confirm with an agriculture officer or 16123.

Safety gate: about 4% of everyday photos and 14% of other-crop leaves still get an answer; about 2% of real rice photos from other districts are wrongly called "not a leaf". On Savar photos the app now answers only 37% of the time and "Healthy" is right 64% of the time, so it must be field-tested before wider use.

safety_gate.summary_en: Two extra checks run before an answer is shown: a leaf-colour check rejects photos that are not leaves, and "Healthy" is only said at high confidence (>= 90%), because wrongly telling a farmer to do nothing is the costliest error. Thresholds were chosen on the validation split and on half of the other sets; the numbers below come from data not used for tuning. Coverage here counts leaf smut as "not sure".
safety_gate.summary_bn: উত্তর দেখানোর আগে দুটি বাড়তি পরীক্ষা হয়: পাতার রং-পরীক্ষা পাতা নয় এমন ছবি বাদ দেয়, আর "সুস্থ" কেবল উচ্চ আস্থায় (>= 90%) বলা হয়, কারণ ভুল করে "কিছু করার দরকার নেই" বলা সবচেয়ে ক্ষতিকর। সীমাগুলো যাচাই-অংশ ও অন্য সেটগুলোর অর্ধেক দিয়ে ঠিক করা; নিচের সংখ্যা সেই ডেটা থেকে যা সীমা ঠিক করতে ব্যবহার হয়নি। এখানে লিফ স্মাটকে "নিশ্চিত নই" ধরা হয়েছে।
